changed_fields.before: Default pitch system is 12TET. Core tunings are available in Tunings; user files appear under User tag. Hover/select shows description and number of notes per octave in Info View. Browser indexing latency/errors U.
changed_fields.after: Default pitch system is 12TET. Core tunings are available in Tunings; user files appear under User tag. Hover/select shows description and number of notes per octave in Info View. Browser indexing latency/errors U. The same description is shown when hovering the name of a loaded tuning.

changed_fields.before: Load tuning into Set. Browser operations open initially hidden Tuning section; view menu also opens it. Loaded tuning is saved with Set. Precise reference defaults, multiple drop ordering and missing-file behavior U.
changed_fields.after: Load tuning into Set. Browser operations open initially hidden Tuning section; view menu also opens it. Loaded tuning is saved with Set. Precise reference defaults, multiple drop ordering and missing-file behavior U. The browser view control menu opens the section; the triangle beside the loaded file name expands additional settings and Tuning displays the loaded system name.

changed_fields.before: Enable Retune Set On Loading Tuning Systems and load/change tuning.
changed_fields.after: Enable Retune Set On Loading Tuning Systems and load/change tuning. The explicit entry is Options > Retune Set On Loading Tuning Systems.

changed_fields.before: Loaded tuning; enable a MIDI track's Bypass Tuning.
changed_fields.after: Loaded tuning; enable a MIDI track's Bypass Tuning. The track tuning controls appear in MIDI track I/O while a tuning is loaded; no converse unloaded-hide law is asserted.

changed_fields.before: Choose All Keys / Black Keys Only / White Keys Only / Closest in Pitch to Keyboard.
changed_fields.after: Choose All Keys / Black Keys Only / White Keys Only / Closest in Pitch to Keyboard. Use the MIDI track In/Out layout chooser with a tuning loaded.
